name: typingsrc

ca.description: A string or array of strings of trusted certificates in PEM format

defaultSource.description: Override the default installation source (e.g., when doing 'typings install debug')

githubToken.description: Set your GitHub for resolving 'github:' locations

httpProxy.description: The proxy to use for HTTP requests

httpsProxy.description: The proxy to use for HTTPS requests

key.description: Private key to use for SSL

noProxy.description: A string of space-separated hosts to not proxy

proxy.description: A HTTP(s) proxy URI for outgoing requests

userAgent.description: Set the User-Agent for HTTP requests
